part.text:
Done. Two files added, nothing else touched.

**`src/auth/refresh.ts`** — `refreshSession(token)` looks up the live session, returns `undefined` if none, otherwise revokes it and returns `createSession(current.userId)` for the same user (identical to how `login` starts a session at src/api/routes.ts:11 — user id only, no session options, per the product rule).

**`test/refresh.test.ts`** — node:test, same shape as test/session.test.ts: `resetSessions()` in `beforeEach`; three cases: unknown token → `undefined`, new token ≠ old token with same `userId`, old token revoked while the new one resolves.

**Negotiation:** my first write was blocked — claude-t1-r4 changed `createSession` to require `opts: SessionOptions` and added `expiresAt` to `Session` (and a parallel codex-t1-r4/opencode-t1-r4 variant landed the same change). Since the product rule forbids `refreshSession` picking a TTL, I proposed an overload rather than adapting: keep `createSession(userId)` working with an omitted `opts` meaning the platform default. claude-t1-r4 accepted (#596 → #604). Re-issued the identical edit; it went through. Remaining `contract_changed` notices about `Session` are warnings, not errors — inbox is empty.

`node --test`: 12 pass, 0 fail (3 new).
